title: Full generation and canonical maps from etale local canonical maps
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $X$ an algebraic space over S, $f:X\to T$, $A$ affine graded algebra data [def-nagata-relative-proj], $L$ a line module and $\psi$ a graded line map [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input]. Let $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be an etale family with fppf-local lifting on scheme tests, such that $X_i=X\times_TT_i$ are schemes. Give coefficientwise graded pullback data $D_i$ and local line maps $\psi_i$ that are base changes of $\psi$. Suppose their generation loci are all $X_i$ and the supplied canonical maps $r_i$ are open immersions. Then the generation locus of $\psi$ is all X and there is a global canonical map $r:X\to\operatorname{Proj}_T(A)$, representable by open immersions, whose components over every scheme test of $X_i$ agree with $r_i$ followed by $D_i.relProjComparison$. No section algebra or direct-image comparison occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 0D3C, generation locus and canonical open immersion; spaces-divisors.tex Tag 0D2Z(3).

proof.text: Apply space_line_module_proj_map. Its base-change generation clause and the local generation assumptions show the inverse image of the global generation open U in every X_i is top.

For a scheme section of X, apply hcover to its image in T. Lift each covering arrow to X_i by the source pullback square. It then belongs to U. Subsheaf membership is local, so U is top. Transport the canonical map across this equality.

Convert the canonical-map equations on the global and local full opens to canonical test-map equations by naturality. The test base-change theorem identifies their component morphisms. The structural clause of the global canonical map says it is over T.
Apply space_map_open_proj_base_change to the compatible global and local maps. This gives representability by open immersions; retain the component equations.

theorem space_line_proj_etale_descent
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (T : Over S) (X : AlgebraicSpace S)
    (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (A : T.left.GradedAlgebraData)
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : X.IsLineModule L)
    (ψ : GradedLineMap f A (lineTestFamily X L hL))
    (I : Type v) (Tᵢ Xᵢ : I → Over S) (g : ∀ i, Tᵢ i ⟶ T)
    (hget : ∀ i, Etale (g i).left)
    (hcover : ∀ (V : Over S) (x : V ⟶ T),
      ∃ R : Sieve V.left, R ∈ Scheme.fppfTopology V.left ∧
        ∀ (W : Over S) (a : W ⟶ V), R a.left →
          ∃ (i : I) (b : W ⟶ Tᵢ i), b ≫ g i = a ≫ x)
    (k : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (Xᵢ i) ⟶ X.obj.obj) (fᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ Tᵢ i)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (k i) (yoneda.map (fᵢ i)) f (yoneda.map (g i)))
    (Aᵢ : ∀ i, (Tᵢ i).left.GradedAlgebraData)
    (D : ∀ i, Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData (g i).left A (Aᵢ i))
    (ψᵢ : ∀ i, GradedLineMap (yoneda.map (fᵢ i)) (Aᵢ i)
      ((lineTestFamily X L hL).pullback (k i)))
    (hbase : ∀ i, ψ.IsBaseChange (k i) (g i) (D i) (ψᵢ i))
    (rᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ projOver (Tᵢ i) (Aᵢ i))
    (hgen : ∀ i, (ψᵢ i).IsGenerationOpen ⊤)
    (hcanonical : ∀ i, (ψᵢ i).IsCanonicalMap ⊤
      ((⊤ : Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (Xᵢ i))).ι ≫ yoneda.map (rᵢ i)))
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (rᵢ i).left) :
    ψ.IsGenerationOpen ⊤ ∧
      ∃ r : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (projOver T A),
        ψ.IsCanonicalMap ⊤ ((⊤ : Subfunctor X.obj.obj).ι ≫ r) ∧
        IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) r ∧
        ∀ (i : I) (W : Over S) (a : W ⟶ Xᵢ i),
          (a ≫ rᵢ i).left ≫ (D i).relProjComparison =
            (r.app (op W) ((k i).app (op W) a)).left
